Distribution of the ratings by round

Source: R/plot.R
delphi_plot_distribution.Rd

Shows, for each item, the distribution of the expert ratings in every round: a box plot (median, quartiles and whiskers) with the individual ratings overlaid. This is the most direct view of how the panel converges or remains divided across rounds.

Usage

delphi_plot_distribution(
  x,
  indicator = NULL,
  round = NULL,
  items = NULL,
  ncol = NULL,
  points = TRUE
)

Arguments

x

A delphi_data object.

indicator

Indicator to plot. If NULL, the first indicator is used.

round, items

Optional subsets of rounds and items.

ncol

Number of columns of the panel grid.

points

Whether to overlay the individual ratings. Ratings are spread horizontally only, so their values are not altered.

Value

A ggplot object, which can be further modified with ggplot2.

See also

delphi_plot_trend(), delphi_plot_consensus(), delphi_plot_map(), plot.delphi_data().

Examples

x <- delphi_data(delphi_example, expert_col = "expert",
                 round_col = "round", indicator_col = "indicator",
                 scale = list(impact = c(1, 10), plausibility = c(1, 100)))
delphi_plot_distribution(x, indicator = "impact")
